location.section: Point 1: the preliminaries, the basis of dharma practice

paraphrase: First, train in the preliminaries.
notes: Slogan 1 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the four thoughts that turn the mind — the precious human life, death and impermanence, karma, and the faults of saṃsāra.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Regard all phenomena as dreams.

tags.stage_native: don dam byang chub sems (ultimate bodhicitta)

notes: Slogan 2 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Examine the nature of unborn awareness.

tags.stage_native: don dam byang chub sems (ultimate bodhicitta)

notes: Slogan 3 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Let even the remedy be released in its own place.

tags.stage_native: don dam byang chub sems (ultimate bodhicitta)

notes: Slogan 4 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Other renderings: 'Self-liberate even the antidote'.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Rest in the nature of the all-base, the essence (of the path).

tags.stage_native: don dam byang chub sems (ultimate bodhicitta)

notes: Slogan 5 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries differ on the sense of 'all-base' (kun gzhi) here; Gelug commentators read it as the mind's emptiness, not as the Yogācāra ālaya.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Between sessions, be like an illusory being (a child of illusion).
notes: Slogan 6 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Train in sending and taking alternately; let the two ride on the breath.
notes: Slogan 7 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Three objects, three poisons, three roots of virtue.
notes: Slogan 8 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: taking on the attachment, aversion and indifference that arise toward pleasing, displeasing and neutral objects, and giving the corresponding roots of virtue.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: In all activities, train with words (these slogans).
notes: Slogan 9 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 2: the main practice — training in the two bodhicittas

paraphrase: Begin the sequence of taking with yourself.
notes: Slogan 10 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: When the world and its beings are filled with wrongdoing, turn adverse conditions into the path of awakening.
notes: Slogan 11 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: Drive all blame into one.
notes: Slogan 12 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the 'one' is self-cherishing.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: Meditate on the great kindness of all.
notes: Slogan 13 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Be grateful to everyone'.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: Meditating on deluded appearances as the four bodies (of a buddha) is the unsurpassed protection of emptiness.

tags.stage_native: don dam byang chub sems (ultimate bodhicitta)

notes: Slogan 14 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. The ultimate-bodhicitta way of taking adversity as the path.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: The four practices are the best of methods.
notes: Slogan 15 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: accumulating merit, purifying wrongdoing, offering to harmful spirits, offering to the dharma protectors.

location.section: Point 3: transforming adverse circumstances into the path of awakening

paraphrase: Whatever you meet unexpectedly, join it with meditation.
notes: Slogan 16 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 4: applying the practice in a single lifetime

paraphrase: The essence of the instruction in brief: apply yourself to the five powers.
notes: Slogan 17 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: intention (resolve), familiarization, the white seed (virtue), repudiation (of self-cherishing), aspiration prayer.

location.section: Point 4: applying the practice in a single lifetime

paraphrase: The Mahāyāna instruction for transference (at death) is these very five powers; how you conduct yourself matters.
notes: Slogan 18 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 5: the measure of having trained the mind

paraphrase: All dharma converges on one purpose.
notes: Slogan 19 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the lessening of self-grasping.

location.section: Point 5: the measure of having trained the mind

paraphrase: Of the two witnesses, hold the principal one.
notes: Slogan 20 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: one's own mind is the principal witness, others' opinion secondary.

location.section: Point 5: the measure of having trained the mind

paraphrase: Always keep only a joyful mind.
notes: Slogan 21 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 5: the measure of having trained the mind

paraphrase: If you can do it even when distracted, you are trained.
notes: Slogan 22 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Given as the sign (measure) of accomplished training.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Always train in the three general points.
notes: Slogan 23 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: not contradicting one's commitments, not being outrageous in conduct, not being partial.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not lie in ambush.
notes: Slogan 32 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not strike at the heart (the vulnerable point).
notes: Slogan 33 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't bring things to a painful point'.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not transfer the load of the dzo onto the ox.
notes: Slogan 34 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't transfer the ox's load to the cow': do not shift burdens onto others.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not compete (to be first).
notes: Slogan 35 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't try to be the fastest'.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not act with a twist (reverse the practice).
notes: Slogan 36 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: do not do the practice for selfish ends.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not let gods descend into demons.
notes: Slogan 37 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: do not let mind training turn into pride.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not seek others' pain as the limbs of your own happiness.
notes: Slogan 38 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Change your attitude, but remain natural.
notes: Slogan 24 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not speak of others' defects (their 'injured limbs').
notes: Slogan 25 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not think about others' affairs (faults).
notes: Slogan 26 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Purify the greatest affliction first.
notes: Slogan 27 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Abandon all hope of results.
notes: Slogan 28 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Abandon poisoned food.
notes: Slogan 29 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: virtue mixed with self-grasping is like poisoned food.

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not maintain misplaced loyalty (do not hold on to grudges).
notes: Slogan 30 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Renderings differ widely ('Don't be so predictable'; 'Do not rely on a grudge').

location.section: Point 6: the commitments of mind training

paraphrase: Do not retort with malicious words.
notes: Slogan 31 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't malign others'.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do all yogas (activities) by one.
notes: Slogan 39 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: with the single intention of benefiting others.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Train impartially toward all objects; training that is deep and pervasive is vital.
notes: Slogan 48 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Always meditate on those who provoke you (who are hard to love).
notes: Slogan 49 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not depend on other conditions.
notes: Slogan 50 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't be swayed by external circumstances'.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Practise what is most important now.
notes: Slogan 51 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not misplace (misinterpret) things.
notes: Slogan 52 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the six misplacements — of patience, desire (aspiration), taste, compassion, loyalty (priorities) and rejoicing.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not be intermittent.
notes: Slogan 53 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't vacillate'.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Train wholeheartedly (with decisiveness).
notes: Slogan 54 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Free yourself through investigation and analysis.
notes: Slogan 55 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not wallow in self-pity (do not boast of your kindness).
notes: Slogan 56 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Renderings differ.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not be short-tempered (touchy).
notes: Slogan 57 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Also rendered 'Don't be jealous'.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Correct all wrongs by one.
notes: Slogan 40 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not be temperamental (frivolous).
notes: Slogan 58 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Do not expect gratitude (applause).
notes: Slogan 59 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Two things: at the beginning and at the end.
notes: Slogan 41 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the resolve on waking and the review before sleep.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Whichever of the two occurs, be patient.
notes: Slogan 42 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: whether happiness or suffering comes.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Guard the two even at the cost of your life.
notes: Slogan 43 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the general dharma commitments and the mind-training commitments.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Train in the three difficulties.
notes: Slogan 44 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: recognising the afflictions, averting them, cutting their continuity.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Adopt the three principal causes.
notes: Slogan 45 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: the teacher, the mind's suitability, and the conducive conditions.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Meditate that the three do not decline.
notes: Slogan 46 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: devotion to the teacher, joy in mind training, the conduct of the vows.

location.section: Point 7: the precepts (guidelines) of mind training

paraphrase: Keep the three inseparable.
notes: Slogan 47 of 59 in the later (Kongtrul) arrangement; wording recalled, not read. Commentaries: body, speech and mind (from virtue).
